summary:
Iter-79 Release-Blocker verification (5 items). CONFIG/DOCS (static): (1) /app/backend/.env.example (57 lines) and /app/frontend/.env.example (REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL / WDS_SOCKET_PORT / ENABLE_HEALTH_CHECK) exist; `comm` against real .env files shows ZERO keys missing from either template. (2) /app/docker-compose.yml has worker-tuning at line 103 alongside worker-trading(33)/worker-protection(47)/worker-reconciliation(61)/worker-analytics(75)/worker-model(89) — all 6 workers present with Dockerfile.backend + restart: unless-stopped. (3) /app/.github/workflows/release.yml has `ea-compile` job at line 37 on `runs-on: windows-latest` — installs MT5 silently, calls metaeditor64.exe /compile on backend\static\EmergentTradingBridge.mq5, throws on '0 error' mismatch or missing .ex5, uploads `EmergentTradingBridge-ex5` artifact. release job `needs: [suite-from-archive, ea-compile]` (line 71), downloads the artifact into backend/static/, manifest+SHA256SUMS lines include backend/static/EmergentTradingBridge.ex5, published release files list includes .ex5+SHA256SUMS+.sig+.pem. (4) /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js lines 6-7 use `process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL || (typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window.location.origin : '')` fallback and warn when var unset; useLiveStream.js lines 4-5 use the identical fallback. (5) /app/docs/campaigns/ contains both 2026-06-11-simulation-harness-netting.md and -hedging.md (~54 lines each, sections 1-6 all PASS with harness-backed test refs), and docs/MT5_VALIDATION_CAMPAIGN.md 'Evidence status' section (line 12) links to both.

BACKEND API SMOKE (curl through REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL): POST /api/auth/login admin@trading.bot/admin123 → 200 + httpOnly access_token cookie set + user {role:admin, email_verified:true, two_factor_enabled:false}. GET /api/performance/verified → 200 with 7 keys (generated_at/overall/max_drawdown/equity_curve/accounts/integrity/share). GET /api/accounts/broker-comparison → 200 {days, brokers}. GET /api/bot/status → 200 with active/auto_execute/risk_level/etc. GET /api/accounts → 200, 6 accounts.

BACKEND PYTEST FULL SUITE (`cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests -q`, 510s): 2667 passed, 10 skipped, 12 failed, 16 errors out of 2695 collected (98.96% pass rate). All 28 non-passing tests inspected and confirmed PRE-EXISTING — NOT regressions from this session's release-blocker changes: (a) tests/test_iter21_presets_and_payouts.py: 16 setup ERRORS — helper register_and_login uses password 'Pass1234!' which is HIBP-breached (screening added in iter-158, per test_credentials.md line 55) → returns 422 code=breached_password. Fix is to update this test file's password constant, not a product bug. (b) tests/test_iter142_p0_audit_http.py::test_live_symbol_entries_shape_and_fresh: EURUSD_M15 age_seconds=70558 (~19h) in seeded env, expected <7200 — data staleness in preview candles, not code regression. (c) tests/backend_test.py::TestWebSocket + TestSpreadFilter and tests/integration/scalp/* (11 failures) — all require running WS/scalp integration services that aren't up in this env. `git status` shows only release.yml, docker-compose.yml, docs/, and frontend files (api.js, useLiveStream.js, ArchitecturePipeline.jsx, Notifications.jsx, Terms.jsx) modified this session — no backend code paths that could cause scalp/WS/data-freshness failures.

FRONTEND E2E (Playwright, preview URL): FIRST RUN caught a compile error 'Identifier axios has already been declared' in /app/frontend/src/components/ArchitecturePipeline.jsx (duplicate `import axios from "axios"` on lines 2 AND 5). I fixed it by removing the duplicate line 5 (in-scope: import-syntax typo blocking build, no business logic). Post-fix run: login form loads on /login, admin@trading.bot/admin123 authenticates, redirects to / — Dashboard renders with STOIC sidebar, 'SERVICE OPERATIONAL' banner, 5/6 ACCTS chip, market ticker (XAUUSD/BTCUSD/etc), Bot Pulse with RoboForex exhaustion-gate reason, MTF Confluence card, System Architecture toggle. /performance renders integrity-stamp ('BROKER-VERIFIED RECORD 99.8% of 488 closed trades broker-verified · 1 estimates excluded · source: broker_deals · feed 1s ago'), equity-curve AreaChart, 8-account table with real broker labels shown to owner. /brokers renders broker-matrix. Zero non-benign console errors post-fix (only the known WS 403 preview ingress limitation and pre-auth /me 401s filtered out).

EURUSD_M15 candle age 70558s (>7200s threshold) — seeded/preview data staleness, not code. Pre-existing.
Require running WS/scalp integration services; pre-existing infra-state failures.

ui_bugs.issue: Duplicate `import axios from "axios"` on line 5 caused Compile with problems overlay 'Identifier axios has already been declared' blocking the entire app. Fixed by removing the duplicate import statement.

action_items: (Optional test-quality) Update /app/backend/tests/test_iter21_presets_and_payouts.py::_register_unique to use a non-breached password (e.g. 'Kd5#Zt9mW2xVpR7c' as documented in test_credentials.md line 55) so its 16 tests can run again. Non-blocking for release.
(Info) The 11 WS/scalp integration failures and the 1 EURUSD data-freshness failure are pre-existing env-state issues unrelated to iter-79 release-blocker changes — safe to defer.

(Watch-out for future refactors) In ArchitecturePipeline.jsx the axios import is a real dependency (used at line 42); the removed duplicate on line 5 was a leftover from the BACKEND_URL import add. When touching import blocks in components, run `CI=true yarn build` locally to catch parse errors early — a duplicate import fails the CRA build hard.
critical_code_review_comments: release.yml ea-compile: correctly gates on '0 error' in MetaEditor compile.log AND on presence of the .ex5 file — belt-and-suspenders. Good.
release.yml release job needs: [suite-from-archive, ea-compile] — the .ex5 will only ship if BOTH pytest suite from archive AND EA compile succeed. Correct posture.
release.yml manifest+SHA256SUMS include backend/static/EmergentTradingBridge.ex5 — checksums will detect tampering post-publish. Good.

frontend/src/lib/api.js: fallback `window.location.origin` is guarded with `typeof window !== 'undefined'` so SSR/build-time won't crash. warn() is behind !process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL so real deployments with the var set stay quiet. Clean.
frontend/src/lib/useLiveStream.js: identical fallback — same-origin WS still works when var unset. Good consistency with api.js.
docker-compose worker-tuning: uses `python -m workers.tuning`, restart: unless-stopped, same Dockerfile.backend — matches the other 5 workers. Consistent.

docs/campaigns/*.md: both files reference concrete pytest test IDs (test_iter150_netting_hedging::TestEaSourceScenarios, test_iter148_p0_exec_truth, test_iter45_ghost_close_recovery, etc.) — evidence is grep-able and verifiable, not hand-wavey. Good.

ArchitecturePipeline.jsx: had a duplicate `import axios from "axios"` (line 5) — the CRA/babel parser rejects this hard; if CI job frontend-build is BLOCKING (as noted in iter-78), this would have failed a release build. Fix applied. Recommend adding a lint rule `no-duplicate-imports` (already on by default in eslint-config-react-app? verify) or a pre-commit check to catch these fast.

rca of the issue: ArchitecturePipeline.jsx build error: When the BACKEND_URL fallback was refactored across api.js/useLiveStream.js, a copy-paste of `import axios from "axios"` was accidentally left in ArchitecturePipeline.jsx (both lines 2 AND 5). Babel parser rejected it as duplicate identifier declaration → CRA `Compiled with problems` overlay covered the entire login page → users could not log in in preview. Mitigation: removed duplicate line 5. The two failing test buckets (iter21 HIBP + iter142 freshness) and the WS/scalp integration failures are all pre-existing env/test-quality issues; documented for future test-file hygiene but not blocking iter-79 release-blocker acceptance.
